topography.project_purpose: Drops is an NFT lending protocol that allows users to borrow against their NFTs by depositing them as collateral in isolated lending pools. It uses a Compound-like architecture with CEther and CErc721 tokens representing supplied assets and Unitroller/Comptroller contracts managing risk and liquidations.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Drops family consists of multiple isolated lending pools, each with its own Unitroller proxy pointing to a Comptroller implementation that manages risk parameters and liquidations. CEther contracts serve as the interest-bearing receipt tokens for supplied ETH, while CErc721 variants handle NFT collateral, all sharing a common upgradeable proxy pattern.
